reporting-org.narrative: ORRAAs mission is to build the resilience of 250 million climate vulnerable coastal people by 2030, by deploying at least USD$500 million of investment into coastal and ocean resilience through the development of at least 50 novel finance and insurance products.

description.narrative: Fundación CI-Atabey’s Dominican Blue Carbon Exchange promotes mangrove restoration in Montecristi and Puerto Plata, safeguarding these vital ecosystems. By generating blue carbon credits, the project incentivizes conservation while mitigating climate change. Partnering with local communities, NGOs, and government entities, it integrates sustainable management, monitoring, and environmental education. This initiative enhances biodiversity, strengthens coastal resilience, and supports local livelihoods—ensuring mangroves continue their crucial role in carbon sequestration and ecosystem protection.
